subjects.description: The FCAW fill pass on a carbon-steel pipe butt joint: bright arc, molten weld pool and a solidifying bead with regular ripples. Robotic FCAW fill pass on A106 Gr.B pipe: bright arc, glowing weld pool, grey solidified bead with fine ripples and light spatter
subjects.appearance_details: Glowing orange-white weld pool, dark grey solidified bead with slag/oxide film, heat-tint colours on the base metal, occasional spatter.
subjects.relationship: The robot torch deposits the bead while the positioner rotates the pipe
subjects.pose: Torch at a constant work and travel angle
subjects.action: Robotic FCAW fill pass on A106 Gr.B pipe: bright arc, glowing weld pool, grey solidified bead with fine ripples and light spatter
subjects.state_changes: The bead grows steadily along the joint.

background_setting: An industrial pipe-spool fabrication bay: a carbon-steel pipe section clamped in a powered rotary positioner, a six-axis robotic welding arm with a gas-cooled MIG/FCAW torch, welding curtains, steel fixtures, ground clamp and cables, grinding dust on the floor; bright overhead high-bay lighting.

lighting.conditions: Intense arc light dominating a dim cell
lighting.direction: From the arc at the torch tip
lighting.shadows: Hard flickering shadows cast by the torch nozzle
lighting.illumination_effect: Arc glare with bloom, glowing pool, cooler bead behind

aesthetics.composition: Weld pool centred, finished bead trailing behind
aesthetics.color_scheme: Orange-white arc and pool against grey-blue steel

cinematography.camera_motion: Camera rigidly mounted on the torch, moving with it; the pipe surface slides past
cinematography.framing: Extreme close-up of the arc, weld pool and freshly deposited bead
cinematography.camera_angle: Torch-mounted, looking down the joint at about 30 degrees
cinematography.focus: Sharp on the molten weld pool and bead toes
cinematography.lens_focal_length: Macro, welding-camera optics with an ND / auto-darkening filter

context: Robotic welding of ASME B31.3 process piping in a fabrication shop; photoreal rendering that follows the structure of the provided control video exactly
